request: Apply the five review-handling recommendations: pending-version guard, non-failing awaiting-review state with automatic resumption, repository policy, source-attachment decision, housekeeping.
decision: Guard creation in the signing job with an explicit single-version supersede; end pending runs successfully only after payload, license and source verification; resume via a secretless scheduled dispatcher; keep source attached (name-catalog.js is generated); provide a check/apply repository-policy tool; move the listing icon out of the package.
